description: Rich 2026-10-06 'go' to the submerged correction (Codex 1924Z). Applied after spatial_roads_v1: transport lanes are controlled currents in a liquid world, so there is no water/bank exclusion. Habitat legality uses substrate slope and the shared natural obstacles; services reach homes only by lane distance; Photosynthetic Fields depend on sampled light and Silicate Pits on a published extraction zone. Provisional numbers, not balanced.

light.text: Light falls with depth: full where the substrate is at height 1.2 or above, none at -1.0 or below (the deep depressions). A Photosynthetic Field needs light 0.35 to be placed and its rate is multiplied by its light.

extraction_zones.text: Exposed silica on the escarpment top. Reached by a lane climbing the escarpment's southern slope.

spatial.source: Provisional (Claude, 2026-10-06): lane grade 0.7 lets currents follow the submerged depression banks; service reach by lane distance clean flow 40 m, waste 40 m, maintenance 50 m, other 45 m.
